text: とっても　きれいに　なったわ！

structure.jp: とっても　きれいに　なったわ！

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に plus なる says something changes into that state. きれいに　なった = 'became clean'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way of stating something. なったわ = 'it has become, you know'.
